SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_lab_results,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_elevated_bilirubin
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IS NULL OR p.SEX = ''
LIMIT 1
